title: The Picnic Above the Storm
description: On the first thunder day, the guests carry plums to the cloudtop. As they settle in, the tablecloth trails lightning into the valley below.
alt: Six people sit at a cloudtop table set with plums. The indigo hem of the tablecloth turns into violet lightning over the valley below.
pairing: An imagined first-thunder holiday × a cloudtop picnic with a lightning tablecloth
